summary: Iteration 2 covers the new champion computer-use adapters (Claude / OpenAI / Gemini), the OwnEndpoint webhook agent, the /api/endpoint CRUD, the run-reactive 3D crab moods and the arena/keys UI. Backend pytest suite grew from 35 -> 46 tests, all 46 pass (100%). Playwright pass covered login (pro), 4 champion adapter cards + 3D canvases on Home/Builder/Arena, BYOK 412 error surfaced in arena-error, endpoint card connect/rotate/error/disconnect flow with data-testids matching the spec, and champion replay track-crab data-mood transitions (celebrate at last step, snap when stepping back through a click step). No page errors, no shader compile errors. No blocking bugs.

issues: Chromium warns 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' four times from the react-three-fiber canvases. Cosmetic performance warning, not an error; consider using dpr={1} or a lighter shot pipeline if profiling shows jank.

critical_code_review_comments: endpoints.EndpointBody uses pattern=r'^https://' plus a downstream safety.request_blocked check — good. But the second PUT re-uses the same URL and skips the safety check only implicitly (still runs it). If a previously-saved endpoint DNS starts resolving to a private IP later, saving the same URL again will 422 and lose the record via the update path — non-issue for now.

adapters/computer_use.OwnEndpoint uses `session.remaining()` as httpx timeout with no lower bound clamp beyond max(remaining,1.0). If remaining is negative, max(...) still returns 1.0 — fine. Consider adding a soft cap so a long-running endpoint does not consume the whole run budget in one call.
server.py adapters ordering ensures 402 (Pro plan) is checked before BYOK — correct. But is_pro also lets a free user reach the crab (custom-tier) path; verified 402 already gates champions.

Model env vars CLAUDE_CU_MODEL/OPENAI_CU_MODEL/GEMINI_CU_MODEL are referenced as os.environ[...] via property — if any env var is unset the /adapters listing raises 500. Consider .get with a fallback string to keep the endpoint resilient.
